en: Three rooms under a drowned chapel, and the thing that has been growing in them.
The stair goes down further than the map says. Two floors below you, something adjusts its weight.
You taste it before you see it. The air here is more spore than air, and the walls are breathing.
The cistern is a room around a thing, not a thing in a room. It has been waiting the way a root waits. It turns to look.
The breathing stops. All of it, everywhere, at once - and the quiet that follows is worse.
